{"command":"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .tura\script | Out-Null; $script = @'
import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const browser = await chromium.launch()
const page = await browser.newPage()
page.on('console', msg => console.log('console', msg.type(), msg.text()))
page.on('pageerror', err => console.log('pageerror', err.message))
await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3000/prompt/cinematic-still-35mm')
console.log('url', page.url())
console.log('heading', await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Cinematic Still, 35mm' }).isVisible())
console.log('buttons', JSON.stringify(await page.getByRole('button').evaluateAll(bs => bs.map(b => b.textContent))))
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to Cart' }).click()
await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
console.log('bodyHasAdded', (await page.locator('body').textContent())?.includes('Added to Cart'))
console.log('status', JSON.stringify(await page.locator('.status').evaluateAll(xs => xs.map(x => x.textContent))))
await browser.close()
'@; Set-Content -Path .tura\script\probe-detail.mjs -Value $script; $p = Start-Process -FilePath npm.cmd -ArgumentList 'run','dev','--','--port','3000' -WorkingDirectory . -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput .tura\probe-dev.out -RedirectStandardError .tura\probe-dev.err; try { $ready=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 60;$i++){ if($p.HasExited){ Write-Host 'DEV_STDERR'; Get-Content .tura\probe-dev.err -Tail 40; Write-Host 'DEV_STDOUT'; Get-Content .tura\probe-dev.out -Tail 40; throw "dev server exited $($p.ExitCode)" }; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:3000 -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if($r.StatusCode -lt 500){ $ready=$true; break } } catch {}; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; if(-not $ready){ Write-Host 'DEV_STDERR'; Get-Content .tura\probe-dev.err -Tail 40; Write-Host 'DEV_STDOUT'; Get-Content .tura\probe-dev.out -Tail 40; throw 'dev server not ready' }; node .tura\script\probe-detail.mjs } finally { if($p -and -not $p.HasExited){ Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } }","workdir":"C:\Users\liuliu\Documents\tura_workspace\target\project-rebuild-makeup-tanstack-fullstack\pg-r5-dir-repair-a9\projects\makeup-tura-direct","timeout_ms":90000}
